question.text: Let a line <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math> be tangent to the hyperbola <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>16</mn></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> be the line passing through the origin and perpendicular to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math>. If the locus of the point of intersection of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo></math> <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi></math> is equal to ______.

solution.text:
The equation of tangent to the given hyperbola is y=mx±16m2-4    ...i

Hence, l1:y=mx±16m2−4

Given that, l2 is a straight line passing through origin and perpendicular to l1.

So, l2:y=-1mx  ⇒m=-xy     ...ii

On solving equations i & ii, we get

y=-xyx±16-xy2-4  ⇒y=-x2y±16x2-4y2y

⇒y2+x22=16x2-4y2

On comparing the above equation with x2+y22=αx2+βy2, we get α=16, β=−4   

∴  α+β=12
